description: This Science Data Bank deposit provides standardised built-up area delineations for 433 Chinese cities with populations above 300,000 in 2020. The Aerospace Information Research Institute and collaborating researchers derived urban impervious-surface information from Sentinel observations and applied a United Nations built-up-area definition. The own page names the dataset in Chinese and lists CC BY 4.0 with public access. An infrastructure modeller could use the urban extents to define exposed settlement areas, compare service catchments or initialise building and land-cover masks for climate-adaptation scenarios. Coverage is limited to the selected large cities and one year. A built-up boundary does not identify individual buildings, their uses, asset capacity or population distribution within each polygon. The repository summary does not establish file encoding or spatial resolution, so those must be checked before overlaying asset coordinates. The package and classification errors were not inspected by download. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Built-up areas of 433 Chinese cities in 2020
